citation.authors: Alexis AF, Kircik L, Chovatiya R et al

cited_by.title: Eczema on dark skin (atopic eczema, including babies)

record.population: Adults and children with atopic dermatitis in two US trials; about a quarter to a third Black or African American, over half Fitzpatrick IV-VI
record.design: Two 8-week randomised, vehicle-controlled phase 3 trials of tapinarof cream, analysis by race and skin type
record.finding: In both trials more people on tapinarof than on vehicle reached clear or almost clear skin, in every race group. Black or African American: 43.1-47.0% on tapinarof against 17.5-24.1% on vehicle. White: 49.4-52.1% against 12.2-14.5%.
record.note: Industry trial (several authors work for the manufacturer, Dermavant). Eight weeks only. A prescription cream, not the moisturising advice above.
